checks.criterion: FIX VERIFICATION: Shop CRUD is master-only and preserves data integrity (the only failed check from iteration 16)
checks.name: pytest tests/test_tscheck_shop_crud_master_only.py
checks.evidence: 2 passed in 0.89s. Non-master POST/PATCH/DELETE on /api/shops -> 401/403 (confirmed). Master POST /api/shops with unique name -> 201 (fix verified: no more 500/TypeError). Master POST with same name -> 409. Master PATCH edits editable fields; outside_zones=true clears zone to null; setting a zone implicitly clears needs_zone_review unless the request also sends needs_zone_review=true. Master DELETE soft-disables (disabled=true, record still present in Mongo). GET /api/shops hides disabled rows by default; GET /api/shops?include_disabled=1 includes them. Post-run DB check: total shops=15 after test run (1 residual tscheck- shop from iteration 16's partial run), cleaned up via direct delete -> 14 shops remaining, matching the Octavia seed count exactly.
